about: What Are Ya Gonna Do? shows Maurice, the hairy, horned Hormone Monster from the Netflix cartoon Big Mouth, winking with one eye, tongue lolling over a goofy grin, and shrugging with an upturned hand. His pendant whistle hangs from his neck. The pose says "oh well" in the most shameless way possible: something has gone wrong, and he's accepted it with a wink rather than any regret. Captions use it to shrug off a bad situation that can't be fixed.
origin: Maurice is one of the Hormone Monsters on Big Mouth, the animated Netflix series that premiered in 2017, voiced by co-creator Nick Kroll.
usage:
The top box describes the unfortunate situation, and the bottom box is the shrug: "what are ya gonna do?" or a casual "yeah...". The default splits it as "yeah..." on top and "what are ya gonna do?" below, which works as a reply to someone else's post.

It fits lighthearted shrugs about things you've chosen not to fix: ordering takeout again, losing to the same boss, a messy room, impulse purchases, missing the gym. The shameless wink is the point, so the caption should sound resigned rather than upset.
ideas: spent my grocery money on takeout again
didn't do the reading, still showed up
three hours of sleep before work
eh, what are ya gonna do?
bought another game I won't play
